title: Transferable Optimization Network for Cross-Domain Image Reconstruction
summary: We develop a novel transfer learning framework to tackle the challenge of limited training data in image reconstruction problems. The proposed framework consists of two training steps, both of which are formed as bi-level optimizations. In the first step, we train a powerful universal feature-extractor that is capable of learning important knowledge from large, heterogeneous data sets in various domains.
